generation.scope: The generic center on the fifteen-dimensional component is a quartic threefold with exactly thirty ordinary double points. Twenty have simple vertex dimensions one and three, ten have two simples of vertex dimension two. Its function field has an unramified Brauer class of index four and is not stably rational.

open_mathematics: Determine the degree and deformation image of the fifteen-dimensional component in the locus of thirty-nodal quartics and extend the simple-marked charts to exceptional windows.
